parameters.prompt: A richly textured fantasy tabletop roleplaying game environment illustration, the Reflection Gallery deep inside an old coastal industrial dungeon. Two plain narrow wooden display tables stand at the existing locations, the nearer table holds ivory sheets with fine abstract optical diagram lines, the farther table holds a small metal plate and paper side by side. Three square warm amber lanterns on waist-high stone pedestals line the RIGHT side, exactly at their reference positions. Overhead rectangular ceiling mirror panels reflect the corridor without showing any people. The floor remains open and easy to understand for navigation. Intricate believable material detail: fine pores and chips in limestone, seams in slate, subtle oxidized brass patina, delicate scratches on silver, wood grain and worn table edges, softened cloth-like paper fibers. Moody amber lamplight against cool teal reflected shadows, restrained cinematic contrast, ambient occlusion in corners, beautiful hand-painted fantasy environment art, crisp architectural edges, coherent perspective, carefully controlled detail. Quiet mysterious atmosphere, no dramatic action, no clutter added. Retain the unobstructed far doorway as a dark opening without drawing anything beyond it. This is an enclosed underground room, no windows, no sea views, no exterior scenery, no readable text, no symbols containing a puzzle solution.
